title: The house band and moving to saxophone
summary: He lists the regular band there, how he was hired for clarinet but asked to play sax, and how he carried over his clarinet ideas.

Let me get back to this end of time this time. When you first went there, that was the band they had there and they weren't using it after. No. And you went there and played a little. Did you join the band or just?

No, I just played with them that night. And, as a matter of fact, they hired me to play clarinet. And when I got there, I played a few numbers on the clarinet and they asked me could I play the sax? I told them I don't know how to play some numbers on it. And they asked me what key. I told them what key. And they're too hard and I told them. And I've been tearing out everything.

When you first started playing the saxophone, did you try to make the same kind of thing that you were making on the clarinet? Some of them, yeah. I mean, it wasn't a completely new style of playing for you? No, no, no. Some of them I was making on the clarinet.
